Aino is a playable Hydro character in Genshin Impact.

She is a child prodigy and the founder of the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop who created Ineffa and many other intricate machinery. She is an orphan and sees her creations and screws as her "family."[9]

After reaching Friendship Level 6 with Aino, a Krumkake Bolt may be obtained through the character menu.

Musecatcher
Elemental Skill
  • Description
  • Gameplay Notes
  • Advanced Properties
  • Attribute Scaling
  • Preview

Aino throws a Musecatcher forward, dealing Hydro DMG and dragging her along behind it. When the dragging stops, Aino deals AoE Hydro DMG to nearby opponents.
Holding the Skill will cause it to behave differently.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode to adjust the Musecatcher's throwing direction.

  • When this skill hits at least one enemy, it generates 3 Elemental Particles.
Constellation Effects
  • Constellation Level 1, The Theory of Ash—Field Equilibrium: "After Aino uses her Elemental Skill Musecatcher or her Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler, her Elemental Mastery will be increased by 80. The Elemental Mastery of other nearby active party members will be increased by 80 for 15s. The Elemental Mastery-increasing effects of this Constellation do not stack."
  • Constellation Level 4, Butter and Cats and the Law of Energy Supply: "When the Elemental Skill Musecatcher hits an opponent, it will restore 10 Elemental Energy for Aino. Energy can be restored to her in this manner once every 10s."
  • Constellation Level 5, Perpetual Turbine of Metal and Light: Increases this talent's level by 3, up to a maximum of 15.

Precision Hydronic Cooler
Elemental Burst
  • Description
  • Gameplay Notes
  • Advanced Properties
  • Attribute Scaling
  • Preview

Aino deploys a custom water-spraying device, the Cool Your Jets Ducky to establish a Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone.
While active, the Cool Your Jets Ducky will periodically fire water balls at nearby opponents, dealing Hydro DMG.

  • Water balls are fired every 1.5 seconds and up to 9 can be fired during the skill's duration.
    • With Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam, water balls are fired every 0.75 seconds and up to 20 can be fired during the skill's duration.
Passive Effects
  • Passive Talent 1, Modular Efficiency Protocol: "Aino will be granted the corresponding buff effects based on the party's Moonsign. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Her Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler is enhanced: The Cool Your Jets Ducky will fire water balls more frequently, and the water balls will deal AoE Hydro DMG over a larger area of effect."
Constellation Effects
  • Constellation Level 1, The Theory of Ash—Field Equilibrium: "After Aino uses her Elemental Skill Musecatcher or her Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler, her Elemental Mastery will be increased by 80. The Elemental Mastery of other nearby active party members will be increased by 80 for 15s. The Elemental Mastery-increasing effects of this Constellation do not stack."
  • Constellation Level 2, The Principle of Transference in Gear Differentials: "If Aino is off-field while the Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone of her Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler is active, when your active party member hits a nearby opponent with an attack, the Cool Your Jets Ducky will fire an additional water ball at that opponent, dealing AoE Hydro DMG equal to 25% of Aino's ATK and 100% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 5s."
  • Constellation Level 3, Cake and the Art of Mechanism Repair: Increases this talent's level by 3, up to a maximum of 15.
  • Constellation Level 6, The Burden of Creative Genius: "For the next 15s after using the Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler, DMG from nearby active characters' Electro-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, and Lunar-Crystallize reactions is increased by 15%. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Her Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler is enhanced: The Cool Your Jets Ducky will fire water balls more frequently, and the water balls will deal AoE Hydro DMG over a larger area of effect.

Force Limit Analysis
Moonsign Benediction Passive

Miniaturized Detection Sensor
Utility Passive
  • Description
  • Gameplay Notes
  • Preview

Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Nod-Krai on the mini-map.
Additionally, Aino appears to be able to alter the Cool Your Jets Ducky's appearance in some way...

  • Aino must be in the active party for Miniaturized Detection Sensor to take effect, but she does not need to be alive.
  • Only one local specialty will be shown on the mini-map at a time.
  • The following 2 Talents are identical to this talent:
    • A Light in the Dark (Flins)
    • Prayers for the Forest (Lauma)
  • Additionally, the appearance of the Cool Your Jets Ducky can be altered by purchasing Aino's Toolbox from the Workshop's Trove.
